# Acceptance Criteria
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

These criteria operationalize the first technical gate. The approved scope file remains the source for the full MVP acceptance boundary.

## Environment Gate

| ID | Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| ENV-01 | Runtime and version | Supported runtime is recorded with evidence |
| ENV-02 | Database | Supported database and connection method are recorded without secrets |
| ENV-03 | Storage | Application and private-file storage locations are recorded |
| ENV-04 | Staging | A repeatable staging deployment path is available |
| ENV-05 | Operations | HTTPS approach, backup location, and operator are recorded |

## Vertical Slice

| ID | Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| VS-01 | Create participant | An administrator can create or invite a synthetic participant |
| VS-02 | Participant login | The participant can authenticate through the selected method |
| VS-03 | Private access | An unauthenticated request cannot view private content |
| VS-04 | Publish session | An administrator can publish one complete session or lesson |
| VS-05 | Video playback | The authenticated participant can play the supplied video |
| VS-06 | Protected download | The authenticated participant can download the supplied file; direct unauthorized access is denied |
| VS-07 | Revoke access | The administrator can disable the participant and subsequent access is denied |
| VS-08 | Staging deployment | The same slice is available on staging from the recorded source version |

## Approved MVP Scope Addition

| ID | Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|---|
| MVP-01 | Administrator Classroom recordings navigation | From the administrator dashboard, clicking Classroom in the left sidebar opens a separate page where all session recordings are visible. The route is server-authorized and the workflow remains usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile. |

## Evidence

Each result must identify the environment, synthetic account or role, action, expected result, actual result, and evidence path. A missing result is `Blocked`, not `Pass`.
